# Roadmap

The roadmap is directional, not contractual. Later blocks may move when the system teaches us that a different order is more useful.

1. Lego 00 — Thinking in problems, requirements, assumptions, invariants and failure modes
2. Python as an engineering tool
3. Domain modeling
4. State machines
5. Testing and correctness
6. Persistence
7. PostgreSQL and transactions
8. HTTP and networking
9. API design
10. Software architecture
11. Concurrency and `asyncio`
12. Background work, queues and workers
13. Distributed systems
14. Reliability patterns
15. Observability
16. Performance and scalability
17. Containers and deployment
18. Cloud and infrastructure as code
19. Security and multi-tenancy
20. AI-enabled workflows

The project should remain as simple as possible at every stage.
